answer_summary: M(β-CD) = 7 × 180.16 − 7 × 18.016 = 1135.008 g mol⁻¹; reported at three significant figures as 1135 g mol⁻¹ (≈ 1.14 × 10³ g mol⁻¹).
assumptions: β-CD contains 7 glucose units (stated in the shared problem context on Q9-1 and confirmed by the figure label 'n = 7 β-CD').
Each of the 7 α-1,4-glycosidic bonds eliminates one H₂O, so 1 mol of β-CD corresponds to 7 mol glucose − 7 mol water.
M(H₂O) is derived from the IChO 2026 data sheet printed on the inside front cover of theory_problem.pdf: A_r(H) = 1.008, A_r(O) = 16.00.
M𝑤(glucose) = 180.16 g mol⁻¹ is exact as printed, per the problem statement.
Final display follows the TASK.json reporting policy: exactly three significant figures, quantum 1 g mol⁻¹ for a value in [1000, 10000), ties half-away-from-zero.
